texts.facebook:
🐍 graphify — Map your entire project for better AI answers

⭐ 140 222 stars · 🍴 13 385 forks · 🐍 Python · 📜 Apache-2.0

━━━━━━━━━━━━

🧭 WHAT IT DOES
Turn any large project or document collection into an interactive visual map so your coding assistant never loses track of the details.

✨ WHAT STANDS OUT
• Parse ~40 languages locally using tree-sitter AST without sending code to an LLM
• Tag every graph edge as explicitly extracted from source or inferred by resolution
• Generate interactive force-directed graph visualizations in an offline HTML report
• Trace the shortest path and confidence scores between any two nodes in the codebase

📌 WHY IT MATTERS
AI coding assistants frequently hit context limits when searching sprawling codebases, making local AST-driven knowledge graphs a practical alternative to naive file grepping.

🎯 GOOD FIT FOR
Developers using AI coding assistants who need a precise map of large codebases without vector embeddings.

⚡ QUICK START
uv tool install graphifyy

🧭 WHAT IT DOES
An open coding helper lets you describe tasks in plain language while it reads code, edits files, and runs commands across your computer, with approval controls before any changes happen.

✨ WHAT STANDS OUT
• Run in four environments: desktop app, terminal, web browser, or editor extension
• Rewind file changes by conversation turn without touching git history
• Configure custom permission levels to require approval before actions execute
• Integrate as a subagent via DeepSeek Harness using the published plugin index

📌 WHY IT MATTERS
The rise of agent client protocols and multi-interface tooling makes it practical to run fully featured coding agents natively across desktop, terminal, and browser environments.

🎯 GOOD FIT FOR
Developers looking for a self-hosted, multi-interface AI coding assistant with fine-grained permission controls.
